summary: Essential emergency numbers, embassy contacts, and recommended hospitals for Ghana. Whether you are in Accra, Kumasi, or Cape Coast, these are the numbers to have saved before you land.

police.description: Ghana Police Service national emergency line
police.notes: For serious emergencies in Accra, the GPS Emergency Unit can be reached at +233 302 773906. Response times vary significantly outside city centers.

ambulance.notes: Coverage is best in Accra and Kumasi. In other regions, it may be faster to arrange private transport to the nearest hospital.

tourist.description: Ghana Tourism Authority toll-free tourist assistance line
tourist.notes: Available during business hours. For general visitor assistance and referrals.

embassies.name: U.S. Embassy Accra
embassies.emergencyNote: For after-hours citizen emergencies, the main switchboard routes to duty officer

embassies.name: British High Commission Accra
embassies.emergencyNote: For after-hours consular emergencies, call the main number and follow the out-of-hours recording

embassies.name: Canadian High Commission Accra
embassies.emergencyNote: Call the Ottawa Emergency Watch and Response Centre for after-hours emergencies

hospitals.name: Korle Bu Teaching Hospital
hospitals.notes: Ghana's largest hospital. Best for serious emergencies. Can be crowded. The main casualty department handles trauma and critical care.

hospitals.name: Trust Hospital
hospitals.notes: Leading private hospital in Accra. Preferred by expats and diaspora. Accepts major international insurance. Modern facilities with diagnostic labs.

hospitals.name: Nyaho Medical Centre
hospitals.notes: High-quality private facility in Ridge. Used by international organizations and embassies. Emergency, inpatient, and specialist care available.

hospitals.name: Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital
hospitals.notes: Main teaching hospital for Kumasi and the Ashanti Region. Best option for emergencies in the central and northern parts of Ghana.

insurance.nhis: Ghana's National Health Insurance Scheme (NHIS) covers basic services at accredited facilities. Visitors are not eligible but private insurance is accepted at most private hospitals.
insurance.recommendation: Carry travel insurance that covers medical evacuation. Quality private hospital care in Accra is affordable by international standards but major injuries requiring evacuation to South Africa or Europe cost $20,000+.

keyAlerts: Dial 191 for police, 193 for ambulance, 192 for fire. Save these before you land.
Private hospitals in Accra (Trust, Nyaho) are significantly better-equipped than public facilities for non-emergency and specialist care
Medical evacuation to South Africa or Europe is available via AMREF and other providers. Confirm your insurance covers this
The U.S. Embassy emergency line is active 24/7. Use it for citizen emergencies only
In Accra traffic, an Uber to Trust or Nyaho may be faster than waiting for an ambulance
